rankedCandidates.name: egrep
rankedCandidates.reuse: grepCommands(options), -E descriptor, withRegexSession; literal registry definition reusing actual bounded handler and CommandContext bytes/signal/cleanup.
rankedCandidates.blockers: Explicit conflicting matcher-flag policy; truthful alias diagnostics; collision/replacement preflight and standalone factories. No budget reset or dropped stdin provenance.

rankedCandidates.name: fgrep
rankedCandidates.reuse: Existing grepCommands -F fixed-string handler, binary records and awaited output; no new regex/native backend.
rankedCandidates.blockers: Binary/multiple-pattern/contradictory flags; cancellation and session cleanup. Shared future edit surface with egrep.

rankedCandidates.name: column
rankedCandidates.reuse: table-text/internal.ts Inputs, RecordReader, Budget, settings, argument; CommandContext VFS/ByteSource/ByteSink/signal and readBytes/writeBytes.
rankedCandidates.blockers: Bounded buffering for global widths, row/field/work caps, explicit -t/-s/-o/trailing-field behavior. C-byte fixture does not settle Unicode/ANSI/terminal display widths.

qualifications: Historical labels retained separately from factual static availability and recipe-stage qualification.
No diagnostic/env-ordering difference is promoted to an implementation defect.
No current-HEAD score, union, new holdout, native oracle, product import, test or comparison run.
Optional-profile absence is not dormant-implementation availability; safejs is a different explicit command.
Static availability is bounded to the default aggregate/kernel plus unchanged measured sources, not arbitrary host functions/VFS scripts or actual unshadowed-dispatch instrumentation.
Ranked candidates require ROOT assignment; no implementation/ownership grant. du feasibility is not assessed.
